messages:
Anna (Design): Quick check: the dashboard grid feels too tight when rows are collapsed. current vertical gap is 8px and it reads cramped on 13-inch screens. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ui/row-collapse-compact.png
Kevin (Frontend): I saw that in the visual tests too. also the keyboard focus disappears on the expander when rows collapse. likely a CSS stacking/context issue.
Sophie (PM): From user feedback, they asked for higher density but we cant sacrifice keyboard targets. Could we move compact mode to 10px vertical padding?
Tyler (Dev): 10px should be safe. note: the chevron button is currently ~36px tap area which fails touch guideline. a11y-bot: interactive targets must be >= 44x44px.
Anna (Design): OK, propose: keep icon-only expander visually, add visually-hidden text("Expand row" / "Collapse row") and aria-expanded toggle. Use tooltip "Expand row to view details". Update spacing tokens: keep spacing.xs (8) and spacing.s (12) but add a compact alias mapping (compact.rowGap = 10).
Kevin (Frontend): For the focus bug I'll add this fix:
```
.row-expander:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--interactive-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.row-collapsed .row-content { padding-top: 10px; padding-bottom: 10px; }
```
I'll include a regression test.
Tyler (Dev): Please don't rename tokens mid-release. mapping via theme alias is safer.
Anna (Design): Agreed, not renaming. I'll add alias and update the design token doc.
Kevin (Frontend): Also noticed toasts anchored top-right overlap the fixed header when multiple row expands fire quickly. Suggest bumping toast.offsetTop by 8px in compact theme.
Tyler (Dev): Less risky to adjust toast offset than header z-index. we already expose toast.offsetTop token.
Sophie (PM): Goal: ship in next patch release (3.2.1) — non-breaking, no token renames, accessibility improvements.
Anna (Design): Copy tweak: visible label remains icon-only; hidden text reads "Expand row" / "Collapse row". Tooltip unchanged.
a11y-bot: Checklist for PR: aria-expanded present, focusable target >=44x44, correct focus order, screenreader text, contrast >= 4.5:1 for icons.
Kevin (Frontend): Opening PR with code, tests, screenshots, Percy diffs. I'll add the a11y checklist to PR description.
Tyler (Dev): Can someone pair on Percy snapshot review after CI? want to verify row heights didn't regress elsewhere.
Sophie (PM): I'll schedule a 15 min slot at 11:15.
Anna (Design): I'll update the token docs and post the compact alias mapping in design tokens doc. Thanks! :sparkles:
